summary: The Philips Essential Air Fryer HD9252/70 is offered at ₹7,780, with the listing claiming a 35% discount from an M.R.P. of ₹11,995. There were too few matching stores to judge this price.

voices.point: It is quiet, easy to use, cooks food quickly, and provides tasty results.
The air fryer produces good quality food, including crispy chips and reheated leftovers.
The product may not be large enough for two people, requiring a bigger unit.
Instructions are not detailed enough for users to fully utilize its cooking capabilities.
The inner basket has a sharp metal catch that can trap fingers during cleaning.
